candidateReviews.priorityOpinion: P2 static; causal support, final dedup/promotion owned by Root including144
candidateReviews.reviewDisposition: Supports late durable snapshot overwrite across legitimate lease handoff; not merely at-least-once duplicate delivery.
normalConditions: Old process P1 with same normal config/inbox and persistent plain-text A already accepted, delivery awaits actual Mimi start/result or reply.
Shutdown reaches gateway/watch completion: e.g. polling adapter returns on abort and notification watcher idle in cancellable poll, no active notification handler delaying it.
P1 releases explicit file lease while old detached process(A)/persistence is still outstanding; new P2 starts using same valid lease/inbox, no same Queue stop/start.
P2 accepts/persists valid B not already durably completed. P1 later writes its stale whole snapshot lacking B.
timeline: P1 queue.stop sets stopped and clears timers, but process(A) was detached and await deliver is not cancelled or joined.

CLI Promise.all does not include process(A); finally releases token lock. Only exitCode setter exists in CLI, no forced process.exit; independent client timeout/poll callbacks remain a source path for late settlement.
P2 acquires absent lease file using wx, loads same inbox once, enqueues persistent B and resolves accepted handler after persist.
P1 late success OR failure reaches process withMutation and persist regardless stopped. Serialized snapshot excludes new P2 B; no reload/CAS/lease check protects rename.
B can remain in P2 memory and a later P2 persist can repair disk. Only exit before repair causes next inbox load to lack B; external platform replay may still recover and is untested.
candidateReviews.impact: Already-accepted durable inbox state can be withdrawn across a supposedly single-owner handoff. Conditional local restart recovery loss, not every B necessarily lost, not proof of permanent end-to-end delivery loss.
scopeExclusions: Not reporting duplicate A or allowed at-least-once replay.
No invalid DTO, account mismatch, spool materialization failure or artificial same-instance stop/start used.
No actual process/OS/network/FS/SDK/ACK/clock execution; no claim of empirically observed timer/event-loop lifetime.
Underlying native lock/FS security correctness and platform redelivery semantics not certified.

oldCauseDecision: Selected SWC02/03, C8, CHAT-R11-01 are different exact causes. Root144 broader shutdown dedup is separate; reviewer does not claim exhaustive newness or duplicate all history machine visits.
